subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw add `registerControlUiEntryPoint` as a separate public plugin UI API, or fold its launch-token behavior into the existing plugin tab descriptor seam?
rationale: This PR defines a durable plugin SDK, Gateway, and browser-security contract; automation can identify the unsafe paths, but maintainers must choose the permanent API and isolation model.

options.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
options.body: Extend the existing `surface: "tab"` descriptor contract with token launch behavior, keep plugin pages sandboxed, and avoid a parallel public API.

options.title: Approve Separate API After Hardening
options.body: Keep `registerControlUiEntryPoint`, but require iframe-only opaque sandboxing, fail-closed launch errors, docs, and exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For RFC Consolidation
options.body: Leave this PR open but do not merge until the native plugin page and broader Control UI contribution RFC semantics are settled.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
recommendation.body: Extend the existing `surface: "tab"` descriptor contract with token launch behavior, keep plugin pages sandboxed, and avoid a parallel public API.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent Control UI contribution RFC and host-hook foundation that best match this API-shape decision.
